description: Defines data structures, classes, and functions related to UE (User Equipment) configuration within the scheduler component of a 5G NR implementation, including search space info, UE cell configuration, and overall UE configuration.

classes.name: search_space_info
classes.description: Contains configuration and methods related to a search space in the scheduler, including PDCCH candidates, CRB lists, and DCI formats.

classes.name: ue_cell_configuration
classes.description: Holds UE-specific configuration for a particular cell, including BWP, CORESET, search spaces, and related parameters.

classes.name: ue_configuration
classes.description: Represents the overall UE configuration, including associated cells, logical channels, and RRM parameters.

methods.name: get_dl_dci_format
methods.description: Returns the downlink DCI format based on the search space configuration.

methods.name: get_ul_dci_format
methods.description: Returns the uplink DCI format based on the search space configuration.

methods.name: get_k1_candidates
methods.description: Retrieves the list of PDSCH-to-HARQ candidates as per TS38.213, clause 9.2.3.

methods.name: get_pdcch_candidates
methods.description: Retrieves all PDCCH candidates for a given aggregation level and slot.

methods.name: get_crb_list_of_pdcch_candidates
methods.description: Retrieves CRB lists for PDCCH candidates at a specific aggregation level and slot.

methods.name: get_pdsch_config
methods.description: Returns the PDSCH configuration for a given resource index and number of layers.

methods.name: update_pdcch_candidates
methods.description: Assigns computed PDCCH candidates to the search space.

methods.name: update_pdsch_time_domain_list
methods.description: Updates the PDSCH time domain list based on UE cell configuration.

methods.name: update_pdsch_mappings
methods.description: Updates PDSCH mappings with interleaving bundle size.

methods.name: reconfigure
methods.description: Reconfigures UE cell configuration with new parameters.

methods.name: set_rrm_config
methods.description: Sets RRM-related configuration for UE cell.

methods.name: has_bwp_id
methods.description: Checks if a BWP ID exists in the UE cell configuration.

methods.name: find_bwp
methods.description: Finds BWP configuration by BWP ID.

methods.name: bwp
methods.description: Returns BWP configuration for a given BWP ID.

methods.name: init_bwp
methods.description: Returns initial BWP configuration.

methods.name: bwps
methods.description: Returns list of all BWP configurations.

methods.name: find_coreset
methods.description: Finds CORESET configuration by ID.

methods.name: coreset
methods.description: Returns CORESET configuration by ID.

methods.name: find_search_space
methods.description: Finds search space configuration by ID.

methods.name: search_space
methods.description: Returns search space configuration by ID.

methods.name: is_dl_enabled
methods.description: Checks if downlink is enabled in a given slot, considering measurement gaps.

methods.name: is_ul_enabled
methods.description: Checks if uplink is enabled in a given slot.

methods.name: use_pusch_transform_precoding_dci_0_1
methods.description: Determines whether to use transform precoding for DCI Format 0_1 for C-RNTI.

methods.name: get_pusch_codebook_config
methods.description: Returns PUSCH transmit scheme codebook configuration.

methods.name: get_srs_nof_ports
methods.description: Returns number of SRS transmit ports.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates UE configuration with new parameters.

methods.name: is_ue_cfg_complete
methods.description: Checks if UE configuration is complete for scheduling.
